about:
# Wowhead Quick Link
Mouse over and press CTRL-C on (almost) anything to generate a Wowhead or Armory link. Allows you to quickly look up anything on Wowhead without having to manually search for it. Lightweight and efficient.

Supports generating links to the Wowhead page for quests, achievements, items, spells, buffs, NPCs, mounts, battle pets, factions, or currencies by pressing CTRL-C while mousing over, as well as armory links for player characters. Also supports Raider.IO links by pressing CTRL-SHIFT-C.

Available as an AddOn here: https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/wowhead-quick-link

- Merge pull request #59 from cfonger/fix/secret-aura-taint  
    Guard aura lookups against secret-aura errors  
- Guard aura lookups against secret-aura errors  
    Since 12.1, C\_UnitAuras.GetAuraDataByIndex and GetAuraDataByAuraInstanceID  
    throw when the aura is secret and the caller is tainted, so the existing  
    IsSecret(aura.spellId) check is never reached. Wrap both lookups in pcall  
    and skip the aura when the call fails.  
    Fixes #57  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

## [2.17.0](https://github.com/NielsHeltner/wowhead-quick-link/tree/2.17.0) (2026-09-30)

- Merge pull request #58 from RafaelHGOliveira/forever-support  
    Add WoW Forever support  
- Add WoW Forever support  
    WoW Forever runs on the retail client with the same WOW\_PROJECT\_ID, so  
    detect it by interface version (16000-19999) and:  
    - add WowheadQuickLink\_Camelot.toc (interface 16001)  
    - link to wowhead.com/forever, which has its own database  
    - skip the Armory and Raider.IO links there  
    - enable the Questie tracker/map strategies there  
    - only hook SetRecipeReagentItem/SetUnitAura when the tooltip has them  
    - skip secret values for the NPC GUID and aura spell IDs
